title: "Command Injection Vulnerabilities"
---

# Command Injection Vulnerabilities

Never pass unsanitized input to `eval` or execute unquoted command substitutions:

```bash
# DANGEROUS: If user_input is "test; rm -rf /", eval executes both!
eval "echo $user_input"

# SAFE: Never use eval with untrusted input
printf '%s\n' "$user_input"
```
